newsitem.title: UK: British pensions scheme under fire - paper.
newsitem.headline: British pensions scheme under fire - paper.

text.p: Plans by the British government to transfer all state pensions to the private sector have been criticised by a trade body representing pension fund managers, according to a report in the Financial Times.
The FT said the National Association of Pension Funds (NAPF) said it had "grave concerns" about the scheme, arguing it could threaten the future of the occupational pensions industry.

The NAPF was concerned that a proposal to switch the burden of tax -- from pension payouts to contributions made in work -- would discourage younger people from taking out pensions, arguing that a similar move had led to the collapse of the occupational pension movement in New Zealand, the FT said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
